improvement_suggestions.description: Investigate why spec.json status was set to 'failed' despite successful completion of all deliverables. If this is a finalization-status bug in the research execution agent, patch it so future research items don't need manual status correction at review time.

Research reviews heavily depend on verifying file-existence and line-range claims in the conclusion. Consider a lightweight GCT dimension (or a review pre-flight step) that parses Markdown citations of the form 'path/to/file.ext:line-range' from conclusion.md/plan.md and auto-reports which ones resolve vs. which are stale. Would save manual grep/read work on every research review.

When an action in a research conclusion is 'deferred' because a downstream artifact doesn't exist yet (Action 3 here), the notes.md should create a follow-up task or checklist entry so the deferred work isn't lost if the downstream workshop agent doesn't happen to read research-notes.md. Currently relies on the workshop agent noticing the file.
